about: The puncture tutorial's converged runs, each one `examples/puncture.py` (or `examples/needle_sweep.py`, a Study) through MIME on a GitHub-hosted runner (float64): depth (mm), force on the tip (N) and crack area (mm^2) at every step, with the settings each ran at. `reference`: spike 3D-COST's rows for the 3-D blunt punch at h = 0.1 mm, the same solver run outside MIME (its uniform-step baseline and its all2 configuration).

sweep-gel-h0.1.runner_cpu: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor (and 2 other CPU models)
